contributions.detail: Schedule A (p2) carries the single typed phrase 'None in this period' and no transactions. Printed 'Subtotal for this page $0' and 'Total Contributions Received $ 0' (the printed caption reads 'Sum of all Schedule A pages in this report', i.e. a per-REPORT figure) match Box B (Contributions Received This Period) = 0 exactly. They do NOT match Box C (Year-to-Date) = 655.65. The filer's own row-area wording ('None in this period') states the scope explicitly. Scope is period; the 655.65 of cycle-to-date contributions is disclosed here only as a summary figure and is not itemizable from this document. This CFD form has no separate <=$50 aggregate line, so the le50 keys are null.

gates.balance_chain: Box A 0 + Box B 0 = Box F 0 (closes); Box F 0 - Box D 0 = Balance at Close 0 (closes). Chain closes exactly on the per-period figures. The cycle-to-date figures are internally consistent too: Box C 655.65 - Box E 655.65 = 0, matching the zero closing balance. Cross-filing chain NOT run: only the June-16 Funk filing is in this chunk (an Apr-3 2026 Funk report exists in the county corpus but is outside it); that earlier filing is where this cycle's 655.65 of contributions and expenditures would be itemized.

escalation_note: Born-digital vector PDF; every figure renders crisply at 200 dpi and matches the embedded text layer. No bistable glyphs, so no crop escalation was warranted.
